card.summary: The Rural and Municipal Utility Cybersecurity Act reauthorizes a Department of Energy program through fiscal year 2031 that provides cybersecurity grants, technical assistance, and funding to certain rural and municipal electric utilities. It allows funding to be awarded on a competitive or noncompetitive basis, adds entities that operate defense critical electric infrastructure to the priority list, and protects all information shared under the program from disclosure under federal, state, tribal, or local freedom of information laws.

summary: The Rural and Municipal Utility Cybersecurity Act amends the Infrastructure Investment and Jobs Act to reauthorize and update the Rural and Municipal Utility Advanced Cybersecurity Grant and Technical Assistance Program. It directs the Secretary to provide technical assistance and funding to eligible electric utilities to deploy advanced cybersecurity technologies and share threat information, authorizing appropriations of $250,000,000 for fiscal years 2027 through 2031.

affected_groups.effect: Rural electric cooperatives, certain local government-owned utilities, certain not-for-profit partnerships, and smaller investor-owned utilities may receive technical assistance and funding to protect against, detect, respond to, and recover from cybersecurity threats.

key_provisions: Reauthorizes the Rural and Municipal Utility Advanced Cybersecurity Grant and Technical Assistance Program to provide technical assistance and funding to eligible utilities.
Sets the objectives of deploying advanced cybersecurity technologies and increasing participation in cybersecurity threat information sharing programs.

Grants priority for funding and technical assistance to entities with limited cybersecurity resources, those owning assets critical to bulk-power system reliability, or those owning/operating defense critical electric infrastructure.
Protects shared information by deeming it voluntarily shared and exempt from disclosure under the Freedom of Information Act or similar State, Tribal, or local open records laws.
Authorizes appropriations of $250,000,000 to carry out the section for the period of fiscal years 2027 through 2031.
missing_information: Specific details on the exact amounts allocated annually within the 2027-2031 timeframe.
Specific criteria the Secretary will develop for awarding funding and technical assistance beyond broad statutory priorities.
summary_detail.plain_summary: The Rural and Municipal Utility Cybersecurity Act amends the Infrastructure Investment and Jobs Act to reauthorize and update the Rural and Municipal Utility Advanced Cybersecurity Grant and Technical Assistance Program. It directs the Secretary to provide technical assistance and funding to eligible electric utilities to deploy advanced cybersecurity technologies and share threat information, authorizing appropriations of $250,000,000 for fiscal years 2027 through 2031.
summary_detail.significance: The bill provides a framework and up to $250,000,000 in authorized appropriations from fiscal years 2027 through 2031 to help smaller and rural electric utilities improve their cybersecurity postures and share threat information.
